items.name: MuseAi-Skill-video-editing
items.description: A fleet of one-repo-per-skill packages for AI Muse agents. Each skill is a self-contained folder that a Muse agent reads, follows, and executes. No build step, no package manager, no config — the SKILL.md does all the work.  This repository is the umbrella: it ships five production skills plus the public landing site that presents them.

items.name: canvas-explainer-videos
items.description: Generate narrated explainer videos purely from code - one Canvas HTML file draws every frame, Web Audio synthesizes the music, TTS narrates, Playwright exports frames and ffmpeg encodes an MP4. An Agent Skill for Codex, Claude Code and any SKILL.md agent. 用纯代码生成带解说的科普动画视频，不需要任何图片或音频素材。

items.name: TK-koubo-video
